name: Jungbrunn Kulinarium
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Jungbrunn Kulinarium in Tannheim**

Discover authentic Tyrolean cuisine in the heart of the **Tannheimertal** Valley. Our cozy restaurant invites you to savor traditional dishes like hearty **Kaiserschmarrn**, crispy **Speckknödel**, and tender **Tiroler Gröstl**, all made with the finest local ingredients.

Indulge in our seasonal specialties, from fresh trout straight from the **Inn** River to slow-cooked venison from the surrounding forests. Pair your meal with a glass of crisp **Grüner Veltliner** or a warming **Tiroler Apfelstrudel** for dessert.

Whether you're exploring the **Lechquellengebirge** or taking a break from hiking in the **Karwendel** mountains, Jungbrunn Kulinarium is your perfect stop for a taste of **Tirol**’s culinary treasures.

**Come and experience the warmth of Tyrolean hospitality—we look forward to welcoming you!**
